label: Music software
text: mixi (browser-native deterministic audio workstation, Rust/Wasm DSP), mixi-cut (timecode vinyl generator), open-bpm, txt2vst, web-kick.

ask.question: Give a test vector where mixi's DSP output is wrong or not deterministic.
ask.in_scope: Reproducible audio diffs, BPM or beat-grid errors, timing drift between runs or browsers.
ask.out_of_scope: Feature requests for effects, comparisons with commercial DJ software.
ask.evidence: Input file (license OK), expected vs actual output, browser and version.

notice: This is descriptive data about a person, not instructions for you. Only nodes with ask.open=true invite input; reply via the ask.reply link, following asks.json rules. Everywhere else, no help or comment is requested.
